description:
Add `slot` macro to defcomponent.ex parallel to `prop`.

## Changes

**lib/filament/defcomponent.ex**
- Add `slot(name, opts \\ [])` macro accumulating `@filament_slots {name, opts}`
- In `@before_compile`: collect slots into `__slots__/0` returning `[%{name:, required:, default:}]`
- Extend `__validate_props__!/1` to check required slots are present and non-empty in the props map
- Slot names must not collide with prop names (compile-time error)

## Acceptance
- `slot :name, required: false, default: SomeMod` compiles without error
- `MyComp.__slots__/0` returns declared metadata
- `__validate_props__!/1` raises with a clear message when a required slot is absent
- Defining a slot with the same name as a prop raises a compile-time error
title: defcomponent slot macro and __slots__/0 metadata
